entries.description: Every product page of Ramses Bazaar, a boho, ethnic and hippie gift shop in Kalamata, Greece, since 1996: jewellery, clothes, home decor, incense and collectibles from Egypt, the Middle East and around the world. Each page has the price, stock and a photo, and orders ship across Greece.
